name: Window or door unit (generic)
description: A placeholder window or door unit that fills a framed opening until a specific product is picked. Builders add one to every opening. Listed first on purpose.

name: Single-hung window
description: Vinyl single-hung window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Bottom sash slides up.

name: Double-hung window
description: Vinyl double-hung window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Both sashes slide and tilt in for cleaning.

name: Casement window
description: Vinyl casement window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Hinged at the side, cranks out.

name: Sliding window
description: Vinyl horizontal sliding window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin.

name: Awning window
description: Vinyl awning window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Hinged at the top, opens out.

name: Fixed (picture) window
description: Vinyl fixed picture window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Does not open.

name: Entry door (prehung)
description: Prehung fiberglass exterior door, 36 x 80in, in its frame. Glass panels in doors must be safety glazing.

name: French patio door (prehung)
description: Prehung double French patio door, about 60 x 80in, tempered glass.

name: Sliding glass door
description: Vinyl sliding patio door, 72 x 80in, tempered double-pane low-E glass.

name: Tempered safety glass
description: Tempered glass panel: required near pools, in doors and next to them, and in other hazardous locations.

name: Bay window
description: Vinyl bay window, about 72 x 48in: a fixed centre lite flanked by two angled operating windows, projecting from the wall. Ordinary double-pane glass, not safety glazing. Planning estimate.
source: Estimate: about 175 lb (roughly 20 sq ft of double-pane glass at about 3.3 psf plus vinyl frame, head and seat boards; no maker shipping weight found) over a 72 x 48 x 18in box

name: Bifold closet door
description: Interior bifold door, 36 x 80in, hollow-core hardboard or MDF panels with track and pivot hardware. Interior use only.
source: Estimate: about 22 lb for a hollow-core 36 x 80 bifold (Home Depot lists 24 lb for an unfinished pine plantation louver bifold, 48 lb for a finished pine louver; no hollow-core weight found) over a 36 x 80 x 1-3/8in slab

name: Barn door with sliding track kit
description: Interior sliding barn door slab, about 36 x 84in, with a 6-6.6ft top-mounted track, rollers and floor guide. Hangs from a header or backer board that must carry the door weight.
source: Listed door-plus-hardware weights for 36 x 84 kits: VEVOR spruce kit 71.2 lb (Newegg), Dextrus H-frame 74.52 lb (Walmart), ANZZI British Brace 78 lb (Ferguson); 75 lb over a 36 x 84 x 1-1/2in slab

name: Garage door, 9 x 7ft insulated steel sectional
description: Insulated steel sectional (overhead) garage door, 9 x 7ft, 2in thick, door sections and track only. The opener and spring setup are extra; springs are usually set by an installer.
source: Estimate scaled from Clopay Modern Steel 16 x 7 R18.4 insulated, 276 lb assembled (Home Depot Canada spec): 2.46 psf x 63 sq ft = about 155 lb, over a 108 x 84 x 2in door

name: Skylight, fixed deck-mount
description: Fixed deck-mounted skylight (VELUX FS C06 class, about 21-1/2 x 46-1/4in), tempered outer pane and laminated inner pane. Flashing kit sold separately; for roof pitches of 14 to 85 degrees.
source: VELUX FS C06: 21-1/2 x 46-1/4 x 4-1/2in outside frame, package weight 39.70 lb (Home Hardware listing), pitch 14-85 degrees; 39.7 lb over that box
